result.title: TIDE: Trajectory-Informed Skill Distillation for Efficient Text-to-Video Prompt Optimization
result.summary: Text-to-video (T2V) models are highly sensitive to prompt specificity, while iterative prompt optimization typically improves generation quality only through repeated video generation and vision-language model evaluation at inference time. We propose TIDE, a framework that distills this costly search process into an interpretable and reusable prompt-rewriting Skill. TIDE formulates prompt rewriting as a set of source-conditioned rule modules, each targeting a distinct semantic dimension. Once distilled, the frozen Skill activates the relevant rules and generates both positive and negative prompts in a single LLM call, followed by only one T2V generation, without test-time visual search or backbone fine-tuning. Evolved using only 100 prompts over 14 hours, TIDE achieves prompt-optimization performance comparable to computationally expensive search-based methods. Moreover, when transferred to previously unseen video-generation models, TIDE outperforms existing approaches specifically designed or trained for those models. Code is available at https://github.com/xiningin/TIDE_T2V.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 TIDE，把昂贵的迭代式提示优化搜索蒸馏成一组按语义维度划分、以源条件激活的规则模块，形成可冻结复用的提示改写 Skill，单次 LLM 调用即产出正负提示并只做一次 T2V 生成，无需测试时视觉搜索或主干微调。
AI.relevance_reason: 将「生成—评估」搜索轨迹蒸馏为冻结可复用策略、从而免除测试时搜索的思路，可能为 LVR 中的轨迹监督与推理成本/停止决策提供可供核查的方法线索，但其任务域为 T2V 提示优化，与视觉推理主线无直接关联。
